title: Which rule decides?
intro: This project allows test commands, denies git push and asks about everything else. Type a command Claude wants to run and see which rule applies.

show.title: Denied
show.detail: The command matches the deny rule Bash(git push *). Deny rules are checked first and always win, so Claude can't run it in any mode.

trace.text: Checks deny rules: Bash(git push *) matches.
The command is refused and Claude is told why.

show.title: Allowed without asking
show.detail: No deny or ask rule matches, and the allow rule Bash(npm run test *) does, so the command runs straight away.

trace.text: No deny or ask rule matches.
Allow rule Bash(npm run test *) matches: runs without a prompt.

show.title: Claude Code asks you
show.detail: No rule matches this command, so you get a prompt. Choosing "don't ask again" would save an allow rule for this project.

trace.text: No deny, ask or allow rule matches.
Approve once, approve and don't ask again, or refuse.

fallback.title: Type a command first
fallback.detail: This demo scripts only three cases: git push is denied, npm run test is allowed, and anything else prompts you.

quiz.question: A command matches both an allow rule and a deny rule. What happens?
options: It runs, because allow rules are more specific
It is refused, because deny rules are checked first
quiz.explanation: Rules are checked in the order deny, ask, allow, and the first match decides, so a deny rule always wins.
